title: feat: add MAI Image 2.5 Flash
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `microsoft/mai-image-2.5-flash` on the existing Azure East US Foundry deployment `MAI-Image-2.5-Flash` (Global Standard, 12 RPM): text-to-image and one-reference JPEG/PNG editing. No aliases, no fallback (no provider serves the Flash checkpoint; fal/OpenRouter only carry non-Flash 2.5 at $47/M output), no Pollinations GPU, no secret change (reuses `AZURE_MYCELI_PROD_API_KEY`).
- Contract: `priceMultiplier` 0.75, `paidOnly: false`, `perUserRpm: 12` (= deployment quota). Cost $1.75/M text and image input, $19.50/M image output (1,024 tokens per 1024×1024). Azure retail meters and Cost Management invoices agree on $19.50; the Aug 12 blog's $33/M is not what Azure bills.
- Handler forwards only `model`/`prompt`/`width`/`height` (Azure 400s on `seed`; edits reject width/height). 400 for sides < 768 px, non-16 multiples, > 1,048,576 px, `transparent`, or > 1 reference. Azure `content_safety_violation` maps to 422 `content_policy_violation`; a response without usage is a 502.
- Verified: 65 unit tests (MAI, FLUX helper rename, moderation), full gen `test/image` (508), enter registry/pricing (545), typecheck, biome. Local E2E through gen on `/image`, `/v1/images/generations`, `/v1/images/edits` (URL and multipart): cache replay, all 400 cases, 422 moderation, disconnect/rejoin with one upstream call (Azure Monitor) and one debit, 13-request burst → 12×200 + one per-user 429 (`Retry-After`), zero Azure 429/5xx. Tinybird `generation_event_v2` rows match wallet debits and registry rates exactly. Latency 12.5–18 s generation, 18–22 s edit.
- Known: the moderation reason shows Azure's raw JSON because the image error funnel matches the body before the message (pre-existing for every provider). Supersedes #12676.

gist.headline: A flash in the flowerbed
gist.blurb: MAI Image 2.5 Flash has landed in the hive: quick text-to-image generation and one-reference edits, served from Azure's East US garden. Polli brought exactly one reference picture, because the API has boundaries and apparently good taste.
gist.summary: Added the Azure-hosted `microsoft/mai-image-2.5-flash` image model for text-to-image and single-reference JPEG/PNG editing, with a 12 RPM per-user limit and 0.75 price multiplier.
gist.impact: Users can now generate or edit images with MAI Image 2.5 Flash through `/image`, `/v1/images/generations`, and `/v1/images/edits`, including clear validation and content-policy responses for unsupported requests.
gist.visual_concept: Depict MAI Image 2.5 Flash as a cozy, fast image workshop: Polli uses a tiny artist's visor and carefully feeds one framed reference image into a warm Azure-like cloud-and-terminal machine, while a second canvas blooms into a new picture. Use a visible 12-leaf flower clock or twelve glowing garden lanterns to represent the per-user 12 RPM deployment quota, with code-plants and a small retro monitor showing simple image tiles.
